title: Hip Fracture &
Femoral Neck
Fracture
Rehabilitation

overview: Hip fractures, particularly femoral neck fractures, are serious injuries that frequently affect older adults and require prompt, specialist rehabilitation to prevent long-term loss of function and independence.

At Cambridge Hospital, our hip fracture rehabilitation begins with safe early mobilisation and progresses through weight-bearing exercises, balance retraining, fall-prevention strategies and occupational therapy for daily living activities. Home Care follow-up is available for patients who need continued support at home.
